title: UPS 767 vs Copa 737: The Miami Taxiway Collision — What the NTSB Has Said So Far
description:
The Miami taxiway collision between UPS flight 358 (Boeing 767-300F) and Copa Airlines flight 427 (Boeing 737-800), Saturday, Nov 14, 2026 — explained only with what the FAA and the NTSB have said so far.

According to the FAA, controllers had told the UPS crew to give way to the Copa flight, which had just landed from Panama City. According to the NTSB, the UPS airplane did not stop, and the left winglet of the Copa 737 struck the nose of the 767. Two passengers had minor injuries; the NTSB says the UPS airplane was substantially damaged. This is a breakdown of the official record so far — not a finding of cause. The NTSB has not determined why the airplanes collided and has not assigned responsibility to anyone.
